# Meridian Labs Employee Handbook — About

Meridian Labs is a fictional software company used for this demo. This handbook is the single source of truth for
people policies. Where a policy and a manager's instruction differ, the policy wins. Policies are reviewed every
January. Questions go to people-ops@meridianlabs.example. The handbook has these sections: leave, expenses, travel,
IT security, onboarding, devices, remote work, holidays, benefits, code of conduct, incident process, glossary.

# Leave Policy

## Entitlements (per calendar year)
- Casual leave (CL): 12 days per year, credited in full on 1 January. Casual leave does not carry forward.
- Sick leave (SL): 10 days per year. A medical certificate is required for sick leave of 3 or more consecutive days.
- Earned leave (EL): 18 days per year, accrued at 1.5 days per month. Unused earned leave carries forward up to a
  maximum balance of 30 days. Earned leave above 30 days lapses on 31 December.
- Maternity leave: 26 weeks of paid leave.
- Paternity leave: 2 weeks of paid leave, to be taken within 3 months of the birth.
- Bereavement leave: 5 days.

## Applying
- Planned leave must be applied at least 5 working days in advance in the HR portal.
- Leave of more than 10 consecutive working days needs approval from the skip-level manager.
- Earned leave is encashed at exit at the basic salary rate; casual and sick leave are not encashed.
- Employees on probation can take casual leave and sick leave but cannot take earned leave until probation ends.

# Expense Reimbursement Policy

## Limits
- Meals while travelling: up to ₹800 per day for domestic travel and ₹2,500 per day for international travel.
- Local cab or auto: actuals; a receipt is required for any single ride above ₹300.
- Home internet: up to ₹1,000 per month, reimbursed quarterly.
- Mobile phone bill: up to ₹750 per month.
- Team outing: up to ₹1,500 per person per quarter, approved by the team lead.

## Rules
- Receipts are mandatory for any expense above ₹500. Below ₹500 a self-declaration is accepted.
- Claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date; older claims are rejected.
- Claims are approved by the reporting manager and paid with the next payroll cycle.
- Alcohol is not reimbursable.
- Claims above the category limit are reimbursed only up to the limit; the excess is borne by the employee.

# Travel Policy

- Flights: economy class for flights shorter than 6 hours. Business class is allowed for flights of 6 hours or
  longer, only for employees at grade L5 and above.
- Hotels: up to ₹6,000 per night in metro cities (Bengaluru, Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Pune) and
  up to ₹4,000 per night elsewhere.
- Bookings must be made through the travel desk at least 14 days before departure, except for customer emergencies.
- Travel insurance is mandatory for all international travel and is arranged by the travel desk.
- Per diem for international travel is USD 50 per day when meals are not provided by the host.
- Personal travel combined with business travel must be declared; the company pays only the business portion.

# IT Security Policy

- Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory on all company accounts.
- Passwords must be at least 14 characters and must be rotated every 90 days.
- Laptops must have full-disk encryption enabled; this is enforced by the device management profile.
- USB mass storage is disabled on company laptops.
- Access to production systems requires the company VPN and a ticket reference.
- Suspected phishing emails must be reported to security@meridianlabs.example using the "Report phishing" button.
- Any suspected security incident must be reported within 1 hour of discovery to the security on-call.
- Sharing credentials, including API keys, over chat or email is prohibited.

# Onboarding

- Day 1: laptop, accounts and a welcome session. An onboarding buddy is assigned for the first 90 days.
- Every new joiner has a 30/60/90-day plan agreed with the manager in the first week.
- Probation lasts 6 months. A probation review is held in month 3 and month 6.
- Mandatory trainings (security awareness, code of conduct, POSH) must be completed within 14 days of joining.
- The employee ID format is E followed by four digits, for example E1001.

# Device Policy

- Company laptops are refreshed every 3 years.
- A lost or stolen device must be reported to IT within 24 hours so it can be remotely wiped.
- If a device is lost through negligence, up to 50% of the replacement cost may be recovered from the employee.
- Personal phones may be used for work email only if enrolled in mobile device management (MDM).
- Devices must be returned within 3 working days of the last working day.

# Remote and Hybrid Work Policy

- Hybrid schedule: 3 days a week in the office, Tuesday to Thursday. Monday and Friday are remote by default.
- Core collaboration hours are 11:00 to 16:00 IST; everyone is expected to be reachable in these hours.
- Working from another city is allowed for up to 4 weeks per year with manager approval.
- Working from outside India needs approval from people-ops at least 30 days in advance.
- A one-time home-office stipend of ₹15,000 is available to set up a desk, chair or monitor.

# Holiday Calendar 2026

Meridian Labs observes 12 fixed holidays per year plus 2 optional holidays that each employee chooses from the
optional list. Fixed holidays for 2026 (all locations unless noted):

| Date | Holiday |
|---|---|
| 2026-01-01 | New Year's Day |
| 2026-01-14 | Makar Sankranti / Pongal |
| 2026-01-26 | Republic Day |
| 2026-03-04 | Holi |
| 2026-04-03 | Good Friday |
| 2026-05-01 | May Day |
| 2026-08-15 | Independence Day |
| 2026-09-14 | Ganesh Chaturthi (Mumbai, Pune) / Onam (Bengaluru, Chennai) |
| 2026-10-02 | Gandhi Jayanti |
| 2026-10-20 | Dussehra |
| 2026-11-08 | Diwali |
| 2026-12-25 | Christmas |

Optional holidays (pick 2): Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, Guru Nanak Jayanti, Mahavir Jayanti, Buddha Purnima, Karva Chauth.
The exact list per city for any year is also available from the HR portal holiday calendar.

# Benefits

- Health insurance: ₹5,00,000 family floater covering the employee, spouse and up to 2 children. An optional
  top-up of ₹5,00,000 and optional parental cover can be bought at the employee's cost.
- Term life insurance: 3 times annual CTC.
- Accident insurance: ₹25,00,000.
- Provident fund: 12% employee and 12% employer contribution on basic salary.
- Gratuity: payable after 5 years of continuous service.
- Wellness allowance: ₹10,000 per year for gym, sports or therapy.
- Learning budget: ₹25,000 per year for courses, books and conferences, approved by the manager.
- Employee referral bonus: ₹50,000 for engineering roles, paid after the referred employee completes 3 months.

# Code of Conduct

- Harassment of any kind is not tolerated. Complaints under POSH go to the Internal Committee (IC) at
  posh-ic@meridianlabs.example and are acknowledged within 7 days.
- Gifts from vendors or customers above ₹2,000 in value must be declared to the manager and may have to be returned.
- Conflicts of interest, including outside employment, must be declared in writing.
- The whistleblower channel is anonymous and reaches the audit committee directly.
- Confidential information must not be shared outside the company without a signed NDA.

# Production Incident Process

- Severity levels: S1 (customer-facing outage), S2 (major degradation), S3 (minor issue), S4 (cosmetic).
- S1 incidents must be acknowledged within 15 minutes and have an incident commander assigned.
- S2 incidents must be acknowledged within 30 minutes.
- On-call rotations are weekly and swap on Monday at 10:00 IST.
- Every S1 and S2 incident gets a blameless postmortem within 5 working days.
- Customer communication for S1 goes out within 60 minutes through the status page.
- A helpdesk ticket must be filed for any incident so that it is tracked.

# Glossary

- CL — casual leave. SL — sick leave. EL — earned leave.
- CTC — cost to company, the total annual compensation.
- L-grades — engineering levels L1 (junior) to L7 (principal). L5 is senior staff.
- POSH — Prevention of Sexual Harassment; the IC is the Internal Committee under POSH.
- MDM — mobile device management.
- IC (in incidents) — incident commander, the single owner of an S1/S2 incident.
- Travel desk — the team that books flights and hotels, reachable at travel@meridianlabs.example.
